basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old from Austin, Texas, working as a customer service representative at a local telecom company. I recently got into Pokémon Go, and I'm really enjoying the community aspect of remote raids. I'm also a big fan of the TV show 'Scrubs,' which I like to binge-watch during weekends. In my spare time, I explore different subreddits about mobile networks and health topics, reflecting my interests in technology and personal wellness. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 6-9 PM CST. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time with my friends at local game nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of Pokémon Go, which I started learning through YouTube tutorials and community discussions online. My interest in technology stems from my job, where I frequently engage with mobile network troubleshooting and customer inquiries.
